theorems.statement: ∀ (X Y : Type) [MetricSpace X] [SigmaCompactSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] [MetricSpace Y] [MeasurableSpace Y] [BorelSpace Y] (m : ℝ) (A : Set X) (f : X → Y) (K : ℝ≥0), 0 ≤ m → NullMeasurableSet A (Chapter01.simonHausdorffMeasureReal m) → Chapter01.simonHausdorffMeasureReal m A < ⊤ → LipschitzOnWith K f A → NullMeasurableSet (f '' A) (Chapter01.simonHausdorffMeasureReal m)
